scope: Exploratory failures retained separately from final acceptance; no acceptance push while any required test fails

runs.cause: Initial background MariaDB process ended during fixture initialization.
runs.resolution: Verified the disposable datadir, removed only the partial synthetic database, and ran MariaDB in a managed foreground session.

runs.cause: New project audit context omitted its nullable Student ID, causing a PHP warning.
runs.resolution: Set student_id explicitly to null for project audits.

runs.cause: Concurrent replay observed a stale repeatable-read snapshot after waiting for the Student fence.
runs.resolution: Use current locking reads for schema availability inside transactions; retain durable replay validation.

runs.cause: The UI success fixture attempted to replace an already locked submitted supporting document.
runs.resolution: Use a separate Student with an editable supporting-document chain, preserving the lock rejection.

runs.cause: The separate Student tour overlay was not acknowledged by the browser fixture.
runs.resolution: Acknowledge that specific synthetic Student tour before interaction.

runs.cause: Repeated fixture execution assigned an unchanged title in the stale-snapshot test.
runs.resolution: Make the fixture mutation guaranteed to change the reviewed row.

runs.cause: A newly added historical-download assertion used action=download instead of the actual action=file&download=1 route.
runs.resolution: Exercise the real authorized file endpoint and compare the original bytes.

runs.cause: Notification-count assertion included successful completion notices retained from earlier synthetic runs.
runs.resolution: Assert the exact notice count after the current run’s notification baseline, retaining earlier evidence.

runs.cause: The RPMS completion browser check assumed the member was on the first ten-row page.
runs.resolution: Search for the specific synthetic member before asserting its current stage.

runs.cause: The Node default child-process output buffer overflowed while transferring accumulated rollback snapshots (ENOBUFS).
runs.resolution: Compute complete rollback digests inside the guarded PHP fixture and perform final acceptance on a freshly initialized disposable database.
